VILLAGERS.name: Guard Oswin
lines: Varrow’s gates are open to honest folk.
Bandits on the north road. Watch yourself.

VILLAGERS.name: Guard Tamsin
lines: Move along, citizen.
The Salty Trout serves the best stew in the realm.

VILLAGERS.name: Fisher Pell
lines: Tuna bite at the end of the pier. You need Fishing 12.
That ship? Bound for islands nobody has mapped. One day.

VILLAGERS.name: Merchant Ilsa
lines: Madame Velour sells outfits fit for royalty.
Have you touched a waystone? They remember you.

VILLAGERS.name: Young Kit
lines: I saw a baby dragon in the Menagerie! In Sunspire!
My da says there’s treasure buried near the standing stones.

VILLAGERS.name: Elder Brann
lines: Frost trolls hit hard. Roll away when the ground cracks red.
Sigrid pays double for frost pelts.

VILLAGERS.name: Bog-witch’s apprentice
lines: Morwen’s sacks have… surprises.
Eels swim in the bog pools. Smoke them on a fire.

VILLAGERS.name: Caravan master Idris
lines: The Sand Queen nests in the Kharos ruins to the south.
Gold rocks hide in the dunes. Rashid buys the ore.

VILLAGERS.name: Farmer Hobb
lines: Wolves took three sheep last week!
The windmill has turned for a hundred years.

VILLAGERS.name: Captain Maren
lines: The Seawolf sails for Dragonscale Isle. Hop aboard!

VILLAGERS.name: Captain Maren
lines: Ready to sail home to Varrow?

VILLAGERS.name: Herald Bram
lines: Hear ye! The king seeks heroes to slay the Ashen Wyrm!
The castle gates open to heroes of renown. Someday.

VILLAGERS.name: Bard Lira
lines: ♪ Oh the wyrm of ash, the wyrm of flame… ♪
Every road in the realm ends at Varrow. Or starts there.

VILLAGERS.name: Sergeant Voss
lines: Hit the dummies all you like. They hit back less than trolls.
Out there, monsters stronger than you hit twice as hard. Level up before you wander.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: Welcome to Varrow, capital of the realm.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: West road leads to Mirewatch and the swamps.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: East road runs to Sunspire, across the sands.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate warden
lines: The capital lies beyond. Tap the gate to enter.

VILLAGERS.name: Weary pilgrim
lines: The old mill hasn’t turned in years. They say a huge boar lives by the river.
Half way. Hollow Meadow lies back west, Silkwood ahead to the east.

VILLAGERS.name: Trapper Olga
lines: Keep moving or the cold gets in your bones. The pass alpha hunts at the top.
Half way. Silkwood lies back west, Frostfang Reach ahead to the east.

VILLAGERS.name: Peat cutter Ned
lines: Mind the sinking mud. The toads get bigger the deeper you go.
Half way. Hollow Meadow lies back west, Duskmire ahead to the east.

VILLAGERS.name: Road warden Hask
lines: Chief Rook’s gang robs everyone on this road. Walk in a group.
Half way. Silkwood lies back west, Kingsvale ahead to the east.

VILLAGERS.name: Ferryman Silas
lines: Something huge moves under the black water. Stay on the stones.
Half way. Duskmire lies back west, Kingsvale ahead to the east.

VILLAGERS.name: Caravan scout Nia
lines: Carry water. And watch the canyon rims for bandits.
Half way. Kingsvale lies back west, Sunscar Wastes ahead to the east.

VILLAGERS.name: Ash-walker Brom
lines: The air tastes of sulphur from here on. A stone warden guards the upper road.
Half way. Sunscar Wastes lies back west, Emberreach ahead to the east.

VILLAGERS.name: Forge-master Hilde
lines: Obsidian golems in the southern glass fields drop shards. Bring me shards.
Magma cores come from imps and titans. Hot to hold.

VILLAGERS.name: Ash-seer Oren
lines: Pyraxis wakes when the mountain rumbles. Fire rains where he looks.
Drink a fire ward before you face him. It takes the edge off.

VILLAGERS.name: Dockhand Pip
lines: Lava eels live in the burning lake to the south-west. You need Fishing 18.
The bay here gives tuna. Cast off the pier.

VILLAGERS.name: Scout Kessa
lines: Emberreach. Everything here burns, even the rain.
Cinderhold lies due east along this road. Two bridges over the lava rivers.

VILLAGERS.name: Old salt Morgan
lines: Saltbeard’s crew holds Smugglers’ Key, north of Palmreach. His hat is worth a fortune.
Shellback turtles only fight if you poke them. They hit like anchors.

VILLAGERS.name: Pearl diver Nami
lines: Reef crabs hide pearls in their shells. Bill pays double for pearls.
Swordfish bite off the reefs. You need Fishing 16.

VILLAGERS.name: Captain Isolde
lines: Back to Varrow? The Gull’s Wing sails on your word.

VILLAGERS.name: Captain Isolde
lines: Wreckers’ Landing. Mind the planks, and mind the crabs.

VILLAGERS.name: Castaway Ned
lines: Coralport is east. Cross the rope bridge to Palmreach, then the long one to Coral Isle.
Or take the south bridges over Turtle Sands. Longer, but prettier.

VILLAGERS.name: Digmaster Ulla
lines: We came for old bones. Turns out the old bones come for you.
Lying skeletons are not always dead. Walk wide around them, or walk in swinging.

VILLAGERS.name: Gravewarden Sefa
lines: Dig a grave and you may find coin, dust or a relic. You may also wake whoever is in it.
After dark the fields fill up. The night-risen hit much harder.

VILLAGERS.name: Caravan master Odo
lines: The bone road back to Varrow. Two days, if the wheels hold.

VILLAGERS.name: Bargeman Brask
lines: The Dustrunner goes upriver to the Fossil Lands. Bring a strong arm and a stronger stomach.

VILLAGERS.name: Captain Isolde
lines: The Gull’s Wing sails for the Tidewake Isles. Pirates, pearls and sunshine!

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: Welcome to Highcairn.
Tap the gate to head back out into the wild.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: Welcome to Mirewatch.
Tap the gate to head back out into the wild.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: Welcome to Mirewatch.
Tap the gate to head back out into the wild.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: Welcome to Sunspire Oasis.
Tap the gate to head back out into the wild.

VILLAGERS.name: Jarl Hrothgar
lines: That statue is my grandmother. She punched a frost troll to death.
Rimeclaw, the great white wolf, hunts the Reach every two hours. Bring friends.

VILLAGERS.name: Skald Inga
lines: ♪ The Star-Eater comes twice a day, when the sky goes purple… ♪
Hot mead thaws the bones. Two coppers well spent.

VILLAGERS.name: Granny Wormwood’s cat
lines: Mrrrow.
(The cat stares at the bog. Something big lives there. The Bog Mother wakes every two hours.)

VILLAGERS.name: Lantern-keeper Hob
lines: Keep your lantern lit. The bog eats the careless.
Eels bite in the town pools too. Try the south ones.

VILLAGERS.name: Sultan’s vizier
lines: The Sultan receives no one today. Or any day.
The Sandwraith walks the dunes every two hours. Its hide is worth a palace.

VILLAGERS.name: Snake charmer Farid
lines: Hsss… I mean hello!
The spice market pays double for emberthorn.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: Welcome to Cinderhold.
Tap the gate to head back out into the wild.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: Welcome to Cinderhold.
Tap the gate to head back out into the wild.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: Welcome to Cinderhold.
Tap the gate to head back out into the wild.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: Welcome to Coralport.
Tap the gate to head back out into the wild.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: Welcome to Coralport.
Tap the gate to head back out into the wild.

VILLAGERS.name: Gate guard
lines: Welcome to Coralport.
Tap the gate to head back out into the wild.

VILLAGERS.name: Guide Elara
lines: Welcome, hero! Everyone who sets out into the realm trains here first.
Follow the glowing light. I’ll teach you everything you need.

VILLAGERS.name: Ferryman Oskar
lines: Finish your training and I’ll row you to Ashen Hollow.

VILLAGERS.name: Land Agent Hilda
lines: Land for sale! Your own homestead: a house, fields, animals. The deed costs 5 silver, and you must be at least level 10.
Seeds, feed and fertiliser, right here. Plant today, harvest tomorrow. Well… in a few minutes.

VILLAGERS.name: Farmer Tobin
lines: Land for sale! Your own homestead: a house, fields, animals. The deed costs 5 silver, and you must be at least level 10.
Seeds, feed and fertiliser, right here. Plant today, harvest tomorrow. Well… in a few minutes.

VILLAGERS.name: Guild Registrar Oren
lines: The Guild welcomes every trade. Choose your profession, and I’ll find you honest work.
Work orders pay well. And a Master of any trade is respected from here to Emberreach.

VILLAGERS.name: Guild Clerk Mina
lines: The Guild welcomes every trade. Choose your profession, and I’ll find you honest work.
Work orders pay well. And a Master of any trade is respected from here to Emberreach.

VILLAGERS.name: Archivist Elowen
lines: The sky above Kingsvale is torn. Something is watching through the gap.
Every dungeon in the realm hums with the same note. They are connected.

VILLAGERS.name: Guildmaster Brannoc
lines: A hero alone is a story. Heroes together are a legend. Found a guild, or find one that will have you.
Every guild gets a hall, a bank and a banner. The more you do together, the more it grows.

VILLAGERS.name: Trial-master Garron
lines: The Crown’s arena tests every hero. Siege on the hour, Gold Rush on the half hour.
The monsters in there grow with you. No easy wins.

VILLAGERS.name: Baker Maudie
lines: Fresh bread! Well, fresh-ish. Still warm, anyway.
You look thin. Heroes always look thin. Have a roll.
My grandmother baked for this village through three winters and a dragon. I mean to do the same.

VILLAGERS.name: Woodcarver Ansel
lines: Wood remembers. Every knot is a winter the tree lived through.
I carved half the doors in this village. The other half were carved badly.
Pine for signs, oak for beds, birch for spoons. Never mix them up.

VILLAGERS.name: Arena crier Bess
lines: Kingdom Quests! Every hour at the arena! Fame, coins and a good bruising!
Siege on the hour, Gold Rush on the half hour. Don’t be late!

VILLAGERS.name: Little Tess
lines: Are you a real hero? Have you ever fought a dragon? Was it big? Was it THIS big?
Mum says I can’t go past the well. I went past the well. Don’t tell.
When I grow up I’m going to have a dog AND a sword.

VILLAGERS.name: Barber Lyra
lines: Sit down, sit down! A new cut, a new colour, a new you.
I can change anything: hair, face, even how tall you stand. Magic scissors, don’t ask.

VILLAGERS.name: Barber Finn
lines: Sit down, sit down! A new cut, a new colour, a new you.
I can change anything: hair, face, even how tall you stand. Magic scissors, don’t ask.

VILLAGERS.name: Auctioneer Silas
lines: Buy, sell, bid! Traders from every corner of the realm list their goods here.
Prices rise and fall. Buy low, sell high, and watch what is in demand.

VILLAGERS.name: Auctioneer Wren
lines: Buy, sell, bid! Traders from every corner of the realm list their goods here.
Prices rise and fall. Buy low, sell high, and watch what is in demand.

VILLAGERS.name: Market Warden
lines: Stalls for every trade, rented by the week. Come in and see who has the best prices!
The cheapest honest merchant wins the crowd. That’s the market.

Captain Mara.letter: I watched you chop your first log with an axe twice too big for you. Now look at you. Ashen Hollow is proud. Come and sit by the fire sometime.
Captain Mara.best: You were a stranger off the boat once. Now you are family. My door is always open, and the kettle is always on.

Baker Maudie.letter: The whole Hollow smells of bread again, and half of it is thanks to you. I saved you the crustiest loaf. Do not tell Tess.
Baker Maudie.best: I am writing down my grandmother’s pie recipe for you. Nobody else has ever seen it. Keep it secret, keep it warm.

Woodcarver Ansel.letter: I carved a little figure of you for the inn mantel. The axe is too big, but that felt right.
Woodcarver Ansel.best: My hands shake now, but they still know wood. I made you a walking stick. You will not need it for fifty years. Keep it anyway.

Little Tess.letter: DEAR HERO. I drew you fighting a dragon. The dragon is crying because you are winning. Mum says I have to say thank you for the strawberries. THANK YOU.
Little Tess.best: When I grow up I am going to be a hero like you, but with a dog. Biscuit says hello. (I asked him.)

Fisher Pell.letter: The salmon are running thick by the pier this week. Come early, before the gulls. I will show you my secret knot.
Fisher Pell.best: Forty years I have fished this harbour and never had a friend who could out-fish me. Now I do. I am not even angry.

Young Kit.letter: I practised with my wooden sword every day like you said. I hit the training dummy so hard its hat fell off.
Young Kit.best: Sergeant Voss says I can be a squire when I am older. I told him I already learned from the best.

Merchant Ilsa.letter: A good customer is worth ten good deals. A good friend is worth more. I will pretend I did not write that.
Merchant Ilsa.best: For you, and only for you: no haggling. Well. Less haggling.

Bard Lira.letter: I wrote a song about you. It has eleven verses and a dragon in it. The tavern made me sing it twice.
Bard Lira.best: They sing your song in three kingdoms now. I made sure the chorus gets your good side.

Sergeant Voss.letter: The recruits ask about you. I tell them: shield up, eyes open, and eat your breakfast. You taught me the last one.
Sergeant Voss.best: If you ever need a sword at your back, you have mine. That is not a figure of speech.

Archivist Elowen.letter: I catalogued every star you brought me. The archive has never been so full, or so bright.
Archivist Elowen.best: History will remember the hero. I will remember the friend who carried dusty books up four flights of stairs for me.

Elder Brann.letter: The snows are kind this year. The young ones say it is because of you. I tell them not to be silly. Then I agree with them.
Elder Brann.best: Highcairn carved your name on the old stone, beside the founders. It is a little crooked. So were theirs.

Jarl Hrothgar.letter: Your seat in my hall is warm. Your mug is full. Come drink, and lie to me about how many trolls you slew.
Jarl Hrothgar.best: Hrothgar has many shield-brothers. He has one friend he would follow into the cold. That is you.

Skald Inga.letter: The hall wanted a new saga. I gave them yours. Nobody slept until dawn.
Skald Inga.best: I knitted you a scarf in your colours. It is crooked. Wear it anyway.

Lantern-keeper Hob.letter: Every lantern in Mirewatch burned bright last night. One of them was for you.
Lantern-keeper Hob.best: I named the newest lantern after you. It is the steadiest one. Of course it is.

Granny Wormwood’s cat.letter: (A muddy pawprint, a dead beetle and a single whisker. You think it means “thank you”.)
Granny Wormwood’s cat.best: (The cat has left you its favourite thing in the world: a slightly chewed ribbon. This is a great honour.)

Caravan master Idris.letter: The caravans speak of a traveller who never lets a stranger walk alone. They mean you. Ride with us any time.
Caravan master Idris.best: From the Oasis to the sea, every caravan fire has a place for you. I have told them all.

Snake charmer Farid.letter: My snake Sahar has learned a new dance. It is called “the hero”. It mostly involves biting things.
Snake charmer Farid.best: Sahar trusts nobody. Sahar sleeps on your boots. This is the highest honour of the desert.

Forge-master Hilde.letter: Your blade came back with a nick in it. I fixed it and charged you nothing. Tell anyone and I will deny it.
Forge-master Hilde.best: I have forged for kings. You are the only one I would forge for for free. Do not test that.

Dockhand Pip.letter: Caught a lava eel with my bare hands. Well, with gloves. Well, with a net. It still counts.
Dockhand Pip.best: The other dockhands call me “the hero’s mate” now. I have stopped correcting them.

Old salt Morgan.letter: Sea’s been calm since you sank Saltbeard’s nonsense. Calm seas make for boring stories. Come tell me a better one.
Old salt Morgan.best: Sailed every sea, I have. Never had a mate like you. Fair winds, always.

Pearl diver Nami.letter: I dove the Drowned Reef where you fought the Tide Queen. The water is clear again. I could see all the way to the bottom.
Pearl diver Nami.best: I found a pearl the colour of sunrise. I kept it for a year, waiting for someone who deserved it. Here.

Trapper Olga.letter: The wolves keep to the hills now. My traps are empty and my heart is full. Odd feeling.
Trapper Olga.best: The forest has a hundred paths. I have shown you all of them. That makes you family, by trapper law.

TAMERS.blurb: Ashen Hollow’s youngest tamer. Be gentle.
Raises toads by the river in Varrow.
His fox and owl hunt as one.
Highcairn’s champion. Her pets never feel the cold.
The alchemist’s pets glow faintly. Don’t ask why.
Nobody has beaten her team in years.
